mcp_tools.name: reconciled_portfolio_performance_report
mcp_tools.title: Reconciled portfolio performance report
mcp_tools.description: Submit a portfolio performance manifest (beginning value, period-end values, external flows, optional benchmark, declared returns, holdings, transactions); get deterministic reconciled performance — time-weighted and money-weighted returns, a three-leg reconciliation against the declared data, and benchmark comparison — with status complete / partial / insufficient_evidence and every gap named. Numbers only: no recommendations, nothing labeled optimal.

inputSchema.description: The portfolio performance manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and the 6-decimal serialization rule).

beginning_value.description: Declared portfolio value at the start of the first period.

period_end_values.description: Declared period-end values, one per period.

external_flows.description: Net external flow at the beginning of each period (contributions +, withdrawals −), aligned with period_end_values.

benchmark_returns.description: Per-period benchmark returns (numbers), aligned with the periods.

declared_returns.description: Caller-declared per-period returns, reconciled against the computed returns.

expect.notes: All inputs valid, aligned, and sufficient for complete status. computed_spot_checks: period_returns=[0.100000, 0.100000], TWR=0.210000, holdings_total=1210.000000
